## data process
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(purrr)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)
library(nlme)
library(readxl)
library(viridis)
library(openxlsx)
mobility <- read.csv("/Users/huzeyu/Desktop/UConnHealth/Mobility-Expenditure/data/processed_mobility.csv")
mobility$DIST <- gsub("\\.", "-", mobility$DIST)
agg <- read.csv("/Users/huzeyu/Desktop/UConnHealth/Mobility-Expenditure/data/processd_expenditure2019_2023.csv")
# 使用merge函数合并数据
merged_data <- merge(agg, mobility, by = c("DIST", "YEARMONTHWEEK"))
# 添加新列 YEAR，其值是 YEARMONTHWEEK 列的前四位
merged_data$YEAR <- substr(merged_data$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4)
merged_data$MONTH <- substr(merged_data$YEARMONTHWEEK, 6, 7)
merged_data$YEARMONTH <- substr(merged_data$YEARMONTHWEEK,1,7)
merged_data <- subset(merged_data, YEARMONTHWEEK != "2023")
data2019 <- subset(merged_data, YEAR == "2019")
data2019$EXPENDITURE <- data2019$EXPENDITURE/1644460
data2020 <- subset(merged_data, YEAR == "2020")
data2020$EXPENDITURE <- data2020$EXPENDITURE/1697050
data2021 <- subset(merged_data, YEAR == "2021")
data2021$EXPENDITURE <- data2021$EXPENDITURE/1609040
data2022 <- subset(merged_data, YEAR == "2022")
data2022$EXPENDITURE <- data2022$EXPENDITURE/1669400

USDdata <- rbind(data2019,data2020,data2021,data2022)##in thousand dollars
```

## diff data process
```{r include=FALSE}
data2019 <- data2019 %>% mutate(Week_Number = as.integer(as.factor(YEARMONTHWEEK)))
data2019 <- data2019 %>% mutate(DIST_week = paste(DIST, Week_Number,BIZ, sep = "-"))
data2020 <- data2020 %>% mutate(Week_Number = as.integer(as.factor(YEARMONTHWEEK)))
data2020 <- data2020 %>% mutate(DIST_week = paste(DIST, Week_Number,BIZ, sep = "-"))
data2021 <- data2021 %>% mutate(Week_Number = as.integer(as.factor(YEARMONTHWEEK)))
data2021 <- data2021 %>% mutate(DIST_week = paste(DIST, Week_Number,BIZ, sep = "-"))
data2022 <- data2022 %>% mutate(Week_Number = as.integer(as.factor(YEARMONTHWEEK)))
data2022 <- data2022 %>% mutate(DIST_week = paste(DIST, Week_Number,BIZ, sep = "-"))
#19 20
combined1920 <- inner_join(data2020, data2019, by = "DIST_week", suffix = c("_2020", "_2019"))
diff_data2020 <- combined1920 %>%
  mutate(
    EXPENDITURE = EXPENDITURE_2020 - EXPENDITURE_2019,
    mobility = mobility_2020 - mobility_2019,
    EXPENDITURE_Pchange = 100*(EXPENDITURE_2020 - EXPENDITURE_2019)/EXPENDITURE_2019
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(YEARMONTHWEEK_2020, BIZ_2020,DIST_2020,YEAR_2020, EXPENDITURE, mobility,MONTH_2020,EXPENDITURE_Pchange) %>%
  rename(
    YEARMONTHWEEK = YEARMONTHWEEK_2020,
    BIZ = BIZ_2020,
    DIST = DIST_2020,
    YEAR = YEAR_2020,
    MONTH = MONTH_2020,
    expPchange = EXPENDITURE_Pchange
  )

#19 21
combined1921 <- inner_join(data2021, data2019, by = "DIST_week", suffix = c("_2021", "_2019"))
diff_data2021 <- combined1921 %>%
  mutate(
    EXPENDITURE = EXPENDITURE_2021 - EXPENDITURE_2019,
    mobility = mobility_2021 - mobility_2019,
    EXPENDITURE_Pchange = 100*(EXPENDITURE_2021 - EXPENDITURE_2019)/EXPENDITURE_2019
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(YEARMONTHWEEK_2021, BIZ_2021,DIST_2021,YEAR_2021, EXPENDITURE, mobility,MONTH_2021,EXPENDITURE_Pchange) %>%
  rename(
    YEARMONTHWEEK = YEARMONTHWEEK_2021,
    BIZ = BIZ_2021,
    DIST = DIST_2021,
    YEAR = YEAR_2021,
    MONTH = MONTH_2021,
    expPchange = EXPENDITURE_Pchange
  )

#19 22
combined1922 <- inner_join(data2022, data2019, by = "DIST_week", suffix = c("_2022", "_2019"))
diff_data2022 <- combined1922 %>%
  mutate(
    EXPENDITURE = EXPENDITURE_2022 - EXPENDITURE_2019,
    mobility = mobility_2022 - mobility_2019,
    EXPENDITURE_Pchange = 100*(EXPENDITURE_2022 - EXPENDITURE_2019)/EXPENDITURE_2019
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(YEARMONTHWEEK_2022, BIZ_2022,DIST_2022,YEAR_2022, EXPENDITURE, mobility,MONTH_2022,EXPENDITURE_Pchange) %>%
  rename(
    YEARMONTHWEEK = YEARMONTHWEEK_2022,
    BIZ = BIZ_2022,
    DIST = DIST_2022,
    YEAR = YEAR_2022,
    MONTH = MONTH_2022,
    expPchange = EXPENDITURE_Pchange
  )

USDdatadiff <- rbind(diff_data2020,diff_data2021,diff_data2022)
USDdatadiff$YEARMONTH <-  paste0(USDdatadiff$YEAR, "-", USDdatadiff$MONTH)
##USDdatadiffSeoul doesn't have districts column
USDdatadiffSeoul <- USDdatadiff %>%
  group_by(YEARMONTHWEEK, BIZ) %>%
  summarise(EXPENDITURE = sum(EXPENDITURE),
            mobility = sum(mobility))
USDdatadiffSeoul$YEARMONTH <- substr(USDdatadiffSeoul$YEARMONTHWEEK,1,7)
USDdatadiffSeoul$YEARMONTH <- gsub("-","",USDdatadiffSeoul$YEARMONTH)
```


## barplot data process
```{r include=FALSE}
aggregate_data <- USDdata %>%
  group_by(BIZ, YEAR) %>%
  summarise(overallexp = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE),
            overallmobility = sum(mobility, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 定义一个函数来针对特定地区分组求和
summarize_by_group <- function(data, districts) {
  data %>%
    filter(DIST %in% districts) %>%
    group_by(BIZ, YEAR) %>%
    summarise(exp = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE),
              mobility = sum(mobility, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# 计算每个特定地区条件的总和
commercial_data <- summarize_by_group(USDdata, commercial_districts)
noncommercial_data <- summarize_by_group(USDdata, noncommercial_districts)

# 合并所有数据
barplotdata <- aggregate_data %>%
  left_join(commercial_data, by = c("BIZ", "YEAR")) %>%
  left_join(noncommercial_data, by = c("BIZ", "YEAR"))
barplotdata <- barplotdata %>%
  mutate(BIZ = case_when(
    BIZ == "restaurant" ~ "restaurant",
    BIZ == "entertainment" ~ "entertainment",
    BIZ == "clothing" ~ "clothing",
    BIZ == "medical" ~ "medical",
    BIZ == "education" ~ "education",
    BIZ == "shopping" ~ "shopping",
    BIZ == "homelife" ~ "home appliances",
    BIZ == "travel" ~ "travel"
  ))
restaurant_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="restaurant")
entertainment_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="entertainment")
medical_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="medical")
clothing_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="clothing")
travel_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="travel")
education_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="education")
shopping_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="shopping")
homelife_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="home appliances")
```

## figure 1 Overall trend of excess expenditure and mobility
```{r echo=FALSE}
all_diff_Seoul <- USDdatadiffSeoul %>%
  group_by(YEARMONTHWEEK) %>%
  summarise(diffexp = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE),
            diffmobility = (sum(mobility, na.rm = TRUE))/8) %>%
  ungroup() 
all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTH <- substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK,1,7)
scale_all <- max(abs(all_diff_Seoul$diffmobility))/max(abs(all_diff_Seoul$diffexp))
all_diff_Seoul <- all_diff_Seoul %>%
  group_by(YEARMONTH) %>%
  mutate(x_label = if_else(row_number() == 1, as.character(YEARMONTH), "")) %>%
  ungroup()
# 将 YEARMONTH 的最后两位数字添加到 x_label 中
all_diff_Seoul$x_label <- paste0(substr(all_diff_Seoul$x_label, 6, 7))

# 绘图代码
figure1 <- ggplot(all_diff_Seoul, aes(x = YEARMONTHWEEK)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = diffmobility/scale_all, group = 1, colour = "Mobility difference"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = diffexp, group = 1, colour = "Expenditure difference"), size = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual("", 
                      breaks = c("Mobility difference", "Expenditure difference"),
                      values = c("red", "blue")) +  # Use black and blue for the lines
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Expenditure difference(in thousand USD)",
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . *scale_all/1000, name = "Mobility difference(in thousand)")) + 
  labs(title = "Difference in mobility and all expenditure based on 2019 over the next 3 years",
       x = "Year-Month") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2020-02-02"), color = "black") + 
  annotate("text", x = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2020-02-02"), y = 0, label = "Introduction of COVID-19\nwith social distancing policies", angle = 0, hjust = 0.1, vjust = -4, size = 5,fontface = "bold") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2021-03-01"), color = "black") + 
  annotate("text", x = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2021-03-01"), y = 0, label = "Introduction of\nvaccination", angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -4, size = 5,fontface = "bold") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2022-02-01"), color = "black") + 
  annotate("text", x = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2022-02-01"), y = 0, label = "Relaxing of social\ndistancing policies", angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -4, size = 5,fontface = "bold") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", size = 1.4) + 
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),  
        text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"), # Default text size and style for the entire plot
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),  # Title
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # Axis titles
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), # Axis text
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"), # Legend title
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), # Legend text
        legend.position = "bottom", # 图例位置设置为底部
        legend.direction = "horizontal", # 图例横向排列
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1.5))+ 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = all_diff_Seoul$x_label) +  # 使用新的 x_label 作为 x 轴标签
  annotate("segment", x = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020")[1], 
           xend = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020")[length(which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020"))], 
           y = -Inf, yend = -Inf, size = 1, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020")[1], 
           xend = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020")[1], 
           y = -Inf, yend = -Inf + 0.1, size = 1, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020")[length(which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020"))], 
           xend = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020")[length(which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020"))], 
           y = -Inf, yend = -Inf + 0.1, size = 1, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020")[1] + 
             (which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020")[length(which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020"))] - 
                which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020")[1]) / 2, 
           y = -Inf, label = "2020", vjust = -2, size = 5, fontface = "bold")+
  annotate("segment", x = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021")[1], 
           xend = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021")[length(which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021"))], 
           y = -Inf, yend = -Inf, size = 1, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021")[1], 
           xend = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021")[1], 
           y = -Inf, yend = -Inf + 0.1, size = 1, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021")[length(which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021"))], 
           xend = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021")[length(which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021"))], 
           y = -Inf, yend = -Inf + 0.1, size = 1, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021")[1] + 
             (which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021")[length(which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021"))] - 
                which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2021")[1]) / 2, 
           y = -Inf, label = "2021", vjust = -2, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("segment", x = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2022")[1], 
           xend = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2022")[length(which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2022"))], 
           y = -Inf, yend = -Inf, size = 1, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2022")[1], 
           xend = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2022")[1], 
           y = -Inf, yend = -Inf + 0.1, size = 1, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2022")[length(which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2022"))],
```

## figure 2
```{r echo=FALSE}
barplotdata <- barplotdata %>%
  mutate(`BIZ` = paste0(toupper(substr(`BIZ`, 1, 1)), tolower(substr(`BIZ`, 2, nchar(`BIZ`)))))
# 定义颜色向量
custom_colors <- c(
  "Travel" = "lightblue",
  "Restaurant" = "red",          
  "Shopping" = "lightgrey",
  "Medical" = "yellow",          
  "Clothing" = "blue",
  "Entertainment" = "green",
  "Education" = "orange",
  "Home appliances" = "purple"
)
barplotdata$BIZ <- factor(barplotdata$BIZ, levels = c("Travel", "Restaurant", "Shopping", "Medical", "Clothing", "Entertainment", "Education", "Home appliances"))

figure2 <- ggplot(barplotdata, aes(x = YEAR, y = overallexp/1000, fill = BIZ)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(), width = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~BIZ, scales = 'fixed', ncol = 8) +
  labs(title = "Total expenditure by years and business categories",
       y = "Expenditure in thousand USD",
       x = "Year") +  # 修改图例标题
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Category",values = custom_colors) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),  # 子图背景颜色
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = NA),  # 去除次网格线
        text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # Default text size and style for the entire plot
        plot.title = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), # Title
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # Axis titles
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), # Axis text
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"), # Legend title
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), # Legend text
        legend.position = "bottom", # 图例位置设置为底部
        legend.direction = "horizontal", # 图例横向排列
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"), # facet_wrap 背景为白色
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1.5)) + # facet_wrap 标题为加粗
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))
```

## figure 3_A/B Quadrant plot
```{r echo=FALSE}
data2019$YEARMONTHWEEK <- as.factor(data2019$YEARMONTHWEEK)
data2020$YEARMONTHWEEK <- as.factor(data2020$YEARMONTHWEEK)
data2022$YEARMONTHWEEK <- as.factor(data2022$YEARMONTHWEEK)

data2019overall <- data2019 %>%
  group_by(DIST) %>%
  summarize(
    EXPENDITURE = sum(EXPENDITURE),
    mobility = sum(mobility) / 8
  )
data2020overall <- data2020 %>%
  group_by(DIST) %>%
  summarize(
    EXPENDITURE = sum(EXPENDITURE),
    mobility = sum(mobility) / 8
  )
data2022overall <- data2022 %>%
  group_by(DIST) %>%
  summarize(
    EXPENDITURE = sum(EXPENDITURE),
    mobility = sum(mobility) / 8
  )


data_change_rate_2019_2020 <- data2019overall %>%
  dplyr::select(DIST, EXPENDITURE2019 = EXPENDITURE, mobility2019 = mobility) %>%
  inner_join(
    data2020overall %>% dplyr::select(DIST, EXPENDITURE2020 = EXPENDITURE, mobility2020 = mobility),
    by = "DIST"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    EXPENDITURE_change_rate = (EXPENDITURE2020 - EXPENDITURE2019) / EXPENDITURE2019 * 100,
    mobility_change_rate = (mobility2020 - mobility2019) / mobility2019 * 100
  )
data_change_rate_2019_2020 <- data_change_rate_2019_2020 %>%
  inner_join(district_info, by = "DIST")
data_change_rate_2019_2020$DIST <- gsub("-gu", "", data_change_rate_2019_2020$DIST)


data_change_rate_2020_2022 <- data2020overall %>%
  dplyr::select(DIST, EXPENDITURE2020 = EXPENDITURE, mobility2020 = mobility) %>%
  inner_join(
    data2022overall %>% dplyr::select(DIST, EXPENDITURE2022 = EXPENDITURE, mobility2022 = mobility),
    by = "DIST"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    EXPENDITURE_change_rate = (EXPENDITURE2022 - EXPENDITURE2020) / EXPENDITURE2020 * 100,
    mobility_change_rate = (mobility2022 - mobility2020) / mobility2020 * 100
  )
data_change_rate_2020_2022 <- data_change_rate_2020_2022 %>%
  inner_join(district_info, by = "DIST")
data_change_rate_2020_2022$DIST <- gsub("-gu", "", data_change_rate_2020_2022$DIST)

data_change_rate_2019_2022 <- data2019overall %>%
  dplyr::select(DIST, EXPENDITURE2019 = EXPENDITURE, mobility2019 = mobility) %>%
  inner_join(
    data2022overall %>% dplyr::select(DIST, EXPENDITURE2022 = EXPENDITURE, mobility2022 = mobility),
    by = "DIST"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    EXPENDITURE_change_rate = (EXPENDITURE2022 - EXPENDITURE2019) / EXPENDITURE2019 * 100,
    mobility_change_rate = (mobility2022 - mobility2019) / mobility2019 * 100
  )
data_change_rate_2019_2022 <- data_change_rate_2019_2022 %>%
  inner_join(district_info, by = "DIST")
data_change_rate_2019_2022$DIST <- gsub("-gu", "", data_change_rate_2019_2022$DIST)
data_change_rate_2019_2022$totalpop_inK <- data_change_rate_2019_2022$Totalpop/1000
data_change_rate_2019_2020$totalpop_inK <- data_change_rate_2019_2022$Totalpop/1000
data_change_rate_2020_2022$totalpop_inK <- data_change_rate_2019_2022$Totalpop/1000

figure3_A <- ggplot(data_change_rate_2019_2020, aes(x = mobility_change_rate,
                                       y = EXPENDITURE_change_rate,
                                       label = DIST,
                                       size = totalpop_inK,
                                       color = Daytime_pop_percent)) +
```

## log-log models 
```{r echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(nlme)
library(purrr)

# ===============================
# 1. 构造 total DIST 和 allBIZ
# ===============================
USDdata_totalDIST <- USDdata %>%
  group_by(BIZ, YEARMONTHWEEK, YEAR, MONTH, YEARMONTH) %>%
  summarise(
    EXPENDITURE = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mobility    = sum(mobility, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(DIST = "total")

USDdata_with_totalDIST <- bind_rows(USDdata, USDdata_totalDIST)

USDdata_allBIZ <- USDdata_with_totalDIST %>%
  group_by(DIST, YEARMONTHWEEK, YEAR, MONTH, YEARMONTH) %>%
  summarise(
    EXPENDITURE = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mobility    = sum(mobility, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(BIZ = "allBIZ")

USDdata_with_totalBIZDIST <- bind_rows(
  USDdata_with_totalDIST,
  USDdata_allBIZ
)

# ===============================
# 2. 业务类别
# ===============================
biz_categories <- unique(USDdata_with_totalBIZDIST$BIZ)

all_years_results_AR1 <- list()
coefficients_list_AR1 <- list()

# ===============================
# 3. 主循环
# ===============================
for (biz in biz_categories) {
  
  # ---- 每年总支出（用于后续特征合并）----
  yearly_sums <- list()
  
  for (year in 2019:2022) {
    yearly_data <- USDdata_with_totalBIZDIST %>%
      filter(YEAR == year, BIZ == biz) %>%
      group_by(DIST) %>%
      summarise(sumexp = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    
    colname <- paste0(year, "sumexp")
    names(yearly_data)[2] <- colname
    yearly_sums[[as.character(year)]] <- yearly_data
  }
  
  sumexp_biz <- reduce(yearly_sums, full_join, by = "DIST")
  
  # ---- 每年 AR(1) log-log 回归 ----
  all_years_coefficients_AR1 <- list()
  
  for (year in 2019:2022) {
    
    data_year_biz <- USDdata_with_totalBIZDIST %>%
      filter(BIZ == biz, YEAR == year)
    
    coefficients_biz_year_AR1 <- data.frame(
      DIST = character(),
      slope = numeric(),
      std_error = numeric(),
      p_value = numeric(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    for (dist in unique(data_year_biz$DIST)) {
      
      subset_data <- data_year_biz %>%
        filter(DIST == dist) %>%
        arrange(YEARMONTH) %>%
        mutate(
          time_index = 1:n(),
          log_exp = log(EXPENDITURE),
          log_mob = log(mobility)
        )
      
      # 基本质量控制
      if (
        nrow(subset_data) < 6 ||
        any(!is.finite(subset_data$log_exp)) ||
        any(!is.finite(subset_data$log_mob))
      ) next
      
      model_AR1 <- try(
        gls(
          log_exp ~ log_mob,
          data = subset_data,
          correlation = corAR1(form = ~ time_index)
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      # 若 AR(1) 失败 → 回退为无相关 GLS
      if (inherits(model_AR1, "try-error")) {
        model_AR1 <- gls(
          log_exp ~ log_mob,
          data = subset_data
        )
      }
      
      slope_info <- summary(model_AR1)$tTable["log_mob", ]
      
      coefficients_biz_year_AR1 <- rbind(
        coefficients_biz_year_AR1,
        data.frame(
          DIST = dist,
          slope = slope_info["Value"],
          std_error = slope_info["Std.Error"],
          p_value = slope_info["p-value"]
        )
      )
    }
    
    all_years_coefficients_AR1[[as.character(year)]] <- coefficients_biz_year_AR1
  }
  
  # ---- 重命名列（区分年份）----
  for (year in c("2019", "2020", "2021", "2022")) {
    names(all_years_coefficients_AR1[[year]])[2:4] <-
      paste0(names(all_years_coefficients_AR1[[year]])[2:4], year)
  }
  
  # ---- 合并 4 年系数 ----
  coefficients_biz_AR1 <- Reduce(
    function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "DIST", all = TRUE),
    all_years_coefficients_AR1
  )
  
  # ---- 合并区县特征 ----
  biz_slope_characteristic_AR1 <- coefficients_biz_AR1 %>%
    left_join(sumexp_biz, by = "DIST") %>%
    left_join(district_info, by = "DIST")
  
  # ---- 转成长表 ----
  long_df_biz_AR1 <- biz_slope_characteristic_AR1 %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("slope") | starts_with("std_error") | starts_with("p_value"),
      names_to = c("Measure", "Year"),
      names_pattern = "(.*)(2019|2020|2021|2022)",
      values_to = "Value"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Measure, values_from = Value)
  
  long_df_biz_AR1$BIZ <- biz
  
  all_years_results_AR1[[biz]] <- long_df_biz_AR1
  coefficients_list_AR1[[biz]] <- coefficients_biz_AR1
}

# ===============================
# 4. 单独保存各业务结果
# ===============================
coefficients_travel_AR1        <- coefficients_list_AR1[["travel"]]
coefficients_restaurant_AR1    <- coefficients_list_AR1[["restaurant"]]
coefficients_shopping_AR1      <- coefficients_list_AR1[["shopping"]]
coefficients_medical_AR1       <- coefficients_list_AR1[["medical"]]
coefficients_clothing_AR1      <- coefficients_list_AR1[["clothing"]]
coefficients_entertainment_AR1 <- coefficients_list_AR1[["entertainment"]]
coefficients_education_AR1     <- coefficients_list_AR1[["education"]]
coefficients_homelife_AR1      <- coefficients_list_AR1[["homelife"]]
coefficients_allBIZ_AR1        <- coefficients_list_AR1[["allBIZ"]]
```
